# Email Tracking

Manage email tracking in Teamleader Focus - track emails sent to various entities.

```php
Teamleader::emailTracking()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\General\EmailTracking` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / — / — |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one |

## Endpoints

- `emailTracking.create`
- `emailTracking.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `subject.id` | UUID of the subject entity |
| `subject.type` | Type of subject entity (contact, company, deal, etc.) |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `CREATE_FIELDS` | `subject`, `title`, `content`, `attachments` |
| `SUBJECT_TYPES` | `contact`, `company`, `deal`, `invoice`, `creditNote`, `subscription`, `product`, `quotation`, `nextgenProject` |

## Methods

### `forSubject()`

```php
forSubject(string $subjectType, string $subjectId, array $options = []): array
```

Get email tracking for a specific subject

- `$subjectType` — Type of subject (contact, company, deal, etc.)
- `$subjectId` — UUID of the subject
- `$options` — Additional options (pagination)

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List email tracking entries with filtering

- `$filters` — Filters to apply
- `$options` — Additional options (pagination)

### `createForContact()`


- `$contactId` — Contact UUID
- `$title` — Email subject
- `$content` — Email content
- `$attachments` — Array of attachment file UUIDs

## Examples

Get all email tracking for a specific contact:

```php
$emails = Teamleader::emailTracking()->forSubject("contact", "contact-uuid");
```

Get all email tracking for a specific company:

```php
$emails = Teamleader::emailTracking()->forSubject("company", "company-uuid");
```

Create email tracking for a contact:

```php
$email = Teamleader::emailTracking()->createForContact("contact-uuid", "Subject", "Email content");
```

Create email tracking with attachments:

```php
$email = Teamleader::emailTracking()->create(["subject" => ["type" => "contact", "id" => "uuid"], "title" => "Subject", "content" => "Content", "attachments" => ["file-uuid"]]);
```
